Beginning cash = beginning modified-cash fund balance (p10). Balance sheet: Exhibit I Statement of Net Position (only Governmental Activities column, which is the total). 'Non-Revenue Receipts' split into three fund pieces (ties to 80,237.91). Detail: Schedule M (program x object) supersedes Schedule B (programs only) for General Fund spending, so B is not entered; zero-actual and blank-actual lines (budget-only) are omitted. Schedule M object mapping: Purchased Property Services -> repairs and maintenance, Other Property Services -> professional/contract services, Other Items -> dues, training and travel, Property -> equipment purchases (land and buildings for 4700). Statement of Activities (p2-4) not entered in detail. Schedule N (County Treasurers' General Fund pass-through, p32) duplicates tax/state receipts already recorded and is not entered. Schedule A-1 (p11) and the Depreciation/Employee Benefit/Student Fee disbursements with 0 actuals are not entered. Special Building statement lines: 'Capital Outlay' 144,189.90 = 2610-700 + 4700-700 + 4900-700; 'Other Miscellaneous & Purchased Services' 389,454.11 = remaining lines, both classed capital outlay.
